lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: Your chaos creates patterns. I've been mapping them.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: That's the most frightening thing anyone has ever said to me.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: If I told you I had a plan, would you believe me?

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: If you told me you had a plan, I would check my pockets.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: The running, the fighting, the never-knowing? Absolutely.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: I laughed once. In the third year of my training. It cost me a week's food ration.

lines.speaker: yasha_stonewill
lines.text: I wouldn't know. I still owe myself the ration.
